gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
The scientists carried ___ a series of experiments.
gaps.explanation: carry out = perform, conduct (research, a plan, an order).

gaps.sentence: We need to iron ___ a few details before signing.
Police are looking ___ the cause of the crash.
Please hand ___ your essays by Friday.
gaps.hint: give to a person in authority
gaps.explanation: hand in = give work/documents to somebody in authority.

gaps.sentence: She always gets round ___ washing up by promising to do it later.
gaps.explanation: get round to = finally find time for; here: avoid a duty — test the preposition after get round.

gaps.sentence: The flood wiped ___ the entire harvest.
The hotel was full, so we couldn't check ___.
gaps.explanation: check in = register; check out = leave and pay.
